object_description: three-part building composition forming a motorway-side spine and central entrance cluster
design_condition: The composition is set parallel to the motorway to close the industrial edge and preserve a large flowing northern landscape, while a rear pedestrian route anticipates future site development.

positive.statement: The clear setting along the motorway preserves and strengthens the landscape flowing to the north.
The pedestrian connection convincingly anticipates integration into future site development.
The three building types are well proportioned and lie naturally and quietly in the landscape.
The functional building arrangement is simple and pragmatic.
The internal organization is functional and practical for the processes.
The workplace placement responds to motorway noise and creates good lighting conditions.
The structural proposal largely does justice to the principles of building over ruins.
The project impresses with its attitude toward the location and clear urban setting.

negative.statement: The spatial and functional relationships between the buildings cannot be clearly differentiated.
If only the first stage is realized, the volume stands somewhat randomly in the landscape.
The chosen architectural concept and facade cladding are not convincing for the task.
The high originality of the urban-planning concept is not continued in architecture appropriate to the task.
